features.title: Visual WYSIWYG Editor
features.description: Write intuitively with rich formatting, live A4 document layout, and instant visual feedback without managing raw markup manually.

features.title: Monaco LaTeX Mode
features.description: Toggle into a full-featured Monaco LaTeX code editor complete with syntax highlighting, line numbers, and autocompletion.

features.title: Modular Section Tree
features.description: Organize chapters, sub-sections, and appendices with a drag-and-drop outline tree to keep long manuscripts structured.

features.title: Real-Time A4 Live Preview
features.description: Preview your exact page margins, headers, footers, and page breaks in real time as you write.

features.title: Global Citation Library
features.description: Maintain a centralized repository of BibTeX entries across all your research projects and documents.

features.title: One-Click Citation Insertion
features.description: Search and insert inline citations directly into your text with automatic citation keys and bibliography generation.

features.title: Journal Style Formatting
features.description: Format citations automatically for major academic styles including IEEE, APA, Nature, Springer, and Harvard.

features.title: BibTeX Import & Sync
features.description: Import existing .bib files or sync references directly from Mendeley, Zotero, and Google Scholar entries.

features.title: Research Vector Diagramming
features.description: Draw flowcharts, system architectures, and scientific diagrams right inside Paper Lab.

features.title: Vector & Image Figure Exports
features.description: Export crisp, high-resolution figures in SVG, PNG, and vector PDF formats ready for journal submission.

features.title: Publication-Ready PDF Export
features.description: Compile publication-grade PDF documents with clean typography, headers, footers, and equation numbering.

features.title: LaTeX Source Zip Export
features.description: Download raw compiled LaTeX source archives including figures, templates, and bib files anytime.
